variables.name: api_mode
variables.label: API Mode
variables.description: Choose Chat Completions or Responses request semantics.

variables.name: base_url
variables.label: Base URL
variables.description: API root used with the mode-specific default path.

variables.name: api_path
variables.label: API Path
variables.description: Optional path relative to Base URL. Leave blank to use /chat/completions or /responses.

variables.name: endpoint
variables.label: Legacy Full Endpoint
variables.description: Optional full endpoint override. When set, this takes precedence over Base URL and API Path.

variables.name: image_endpoint
variables.label: Image API Endpoint
variables.description: Optional full Image API generation endpoint. Leave blank to use the bundled OpenAI endpoint.

variables.name: stt_endpoint
variables.label: Speech-to-Text API Endpoint
variables.description: Optional full audio transcription endpoint. Leave blank to use the bundled OpenAI endpoint.

variables.name: temperature
variables.label: Temperature
variables.description: Controls randomness. Lower values are more focused, higher values more creative.

variables.name: max_tokens
variables.label: Max Tokens
variables.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

variables.name: top_p
variables.label: Top P
variables.description: Nucleus sampling. Lower values make output more focused.

variables.name: presence_penalty
variables.label: Presence Penalty
variables.description: Encourages the model to talk about new topics.

variables.name: stream
variables.label: Stream Response
variables.description: Stream the response token by token.
